feeds.title: Carol J. Michel Blog
feeds.description: Carol J. Michel is the award-winning author of five books of humorous and helpful gardening essays, and one children's book. With degrees in horticulture and computer technology, she spent over three decades making a living in healthcare IT while making a life in her garden.

feeds.description: An informed, yet personal take on natural gardening in Indiana and other dirty topics. As a garden coach, Jo Ellen helps clients learn about their landscapes and what to do when, problem-solving and other advice.

feeds.description: If you own a home, it is important to know the facts when hiring a landscaping or tree removal specialist. Read the Indiana Home Landscaping Blog to learn more. Anthony & the team deliver reliable home landscaping, tree removal & lawn care to the residents of Bloomington, IN.

feeds.title: Gardener Shicole Blog
feeds.description: Here you will be able to follow my family's gardening journey, which includes urban gardening and harvest recipes. My name is Shawnta Shicole, and I am a married mother of eight-year-old identical twin boys. When I am not gardening, I am a middle school academic dean.
